subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.------(R)TH.CONT.
description: Diagram in CMBA-7, on the page where Braxton lists several degrees of extended functionalism and accelerated dynamics. (C)TH-CONT — the *concept* of thrust continuance — is crossed with (R)TH-CONT — the *reality* of thrust continuance: a uniquely self-referential crossing where the same term appears with both prefixes, forcing the reader to ask what thrust-continuance-as-concept and thrust-continuance-as-real actually look like together. The main line carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) at a junction: (C)TH-CONT → T-C-IMP → (R)TH-CONT. T-C-IMP branches to C-CONT (composite continuance) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics); (R)TH-CONT branches to AFI (affinity insight) and INFO-DE-B (information degree basis). PROJ-DY branches to INFO-DE (information degrees) and to AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) → LK-IMP (linkage implications).
